verdict: MS-112 is hypothesis-generating development evidence, not a G0 pass or selector result.

observed_issues.insufficient_seed_counts: The three cache-contract episodes have one CACHED_HEAD and one RAW_FINETUNE seed; confirmatory minimum is three.
observed_issues.calculator_behavior: The historical calculator intersected available actions across episodes, silently excluding HEAD_ADAPT from the .085 headroom calculation.
observed_issues.independence: Seven deployment views reuse two tasks; four support views and three Sen12 cache-contract views are correlated, not seven independent tasks.
observed_issues.feature_mismatch: The claimed rule uses support_positive_count, but the input records only support_condition after aggregating eight target regions.
observed_issues.cost_mismatch: Only few-shot adaptation costs were measured; several cache-contract costs were estimates.

preserved_findings: Sen12 and Solar cache reuse/few-shot utility
support composition as a candidate action feature
cache family/scale as a candidate lifecycle feature
